<doc>
1     Emission Standards for Thermal Power Plants as per Ministry's Notification S.O.3305(E) dated 7.12.2015, G.S.R.593 (E) dated 28.6.2018 and as amended from time to time shall be complied.

      Construction work was stopped from 04/2018 onwards by the first EPC contractor and was terminated on 09.12.2018 due to non performance of contractor. 2nd time EPC contract was awarded dated 12.08.2020 and that EPC contract was also terminated by 27/10/2024. So far progress of work- 18.56% (approx.).Now it has been proposed to execute the Project in "as is where is basis" through PPP mode for which tender has been floated with due date on 17.10.2026. After execution and commissioning of the plant the condition will be complied during operation phase.

2     Part C of Schedule II of Municipal Solid Wastes Rules, 2016 dated 08.04.2016 as amended from time to time shall be complied for power plants based on Municipal Solid Waste.

      Will be complied during operation phase.
</doc>
